# The project has no licence, and the photo credits are incomplete
- status: open
- owner: nobody
- stage: 1

The repository is public but has no LICENSE file, so legally nobody (including teammates) has permission to
reuse the code. Choosing a licence is a decision for the people in the group, so it needs a proposal.

Photo credits in `README.md`:

- `legacy/sample-photos/bottle-original/cc0-bottle.jpg` is not credited, not used by any script, and the README's
  "all other sample images were generated by the scripts" is untrue for it. Credit it with its source, or
  delete it.
- The three CC BY-SA 4.0 photos list title, author, and licence but no link to each source page, which the
  licence asks for. The ruler-added versions should be stated to be under CC BY-SA 4.0 as well.

Done when there is a LICENSE file the group agreed on and every third-party photo has author, source link,
licence, and a note of what was changed.

Also needed now that the project uses real part data: credit the LDraw parts library (CC BY 4.0, a few files CC BY 2.0) wherever its
data is used.

This is two pieces of work, and neither needs engine code, so both can start now:
1. A proposal in `docs/decisions/` for which licence the project uses. Nothing is built until it is accepted.
2. The photo credits in `README.md`, which are direct work.
